What's your return and refund policy?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
You can start any return or exchange here: https://nakedwardrobe.com/apps/aftership-returns-center
RETURN POLICY:
- WINDOW: Returns are accepted within 14 DAYS AFTER DELIVERY.
- CONDITION: Items must be UNWORN/UNUSED, with TAGS ATTACHED, in the ORIGINAL PACKAGING, and include PROOF OF PURCHASE.
- STORE CREDIT ONLY: Items returned with MAKEUP, SELF-TANNER, DEODORANT, PET HAIR, OR STAINS are processed for STORE CREDIT ONLY. FINAL-SALE ITEMS are also store credit only.
- RESTOCKING FEE: A flat $9.99 is deducted from each REFUND.
- NON-RETURNABLE ITEMS: INTERNATIONAL ORDERS (EXCEPT CANADA), INTIMATES, BODYSUITS, JEWELRY, ALL MARKDOWN OR SALE ITEMS, and GIFT CARDS.
REFUNDS:
- Once your return is RECEIVED AND INSPECTED, the refund is issued to your ORIGINAL PAYMENT METHOD WITHIN 10 BUSINESS DAYS.
- Your bank/card issuer may take additional time to post it.
- If it has been MORE THAN 14 BUSINESS DAYS SINCE WE RECEIVED YOUR RETURN, please contact NW@NAKEDWARDROBE.COM.
STORE CREDIT:
- If approved for store credit, a NAKED WARDROBE GIFT CARD is sent to the EMAIL ON THE ORIGINAL ORDER after the return is received and reviewed.
EXCHANGES:
- Use the same portal above.
- If you want a SIZE OR COLOR EXCHANGE, select "ITEM DID NOT FIT" in the portal, then choose "REPLACE WITH SAME ITEM".
- If the portal can’t find your order, enter your NW ORDER NUMBER EXACTLY AS SHOWN in your confirmation email.
DAMAGED, DEFECTIVE, OR INCORRECT ITEMS:
Please start through the same portal and include a BRIEF DESCRIPTION, a PHOTO OF THE ITEM, and a PHOTO OF THE CARE TAG INSIDE THE GARMENT.
If you want, I can also help you figure out whether a specific item is return-eligible.
